title: Monthly options expiration (April 2027) — the SPX strip the March VIX settlement is computed from
source: EST: third-Friday convention (2027-04-16 is the third Friday of April 2027 by weekday arithmetic, an unadjusted Friday with no NYSE closure — the nearest 2027 holidays either side are Good Friday 2027-03-26 and Memorial Day 2027-05-31, per nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05, HTTP 200, 109,148 bytes), with a Cboe primary that dates it by contract spec: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,634 bytes, fetched the same day) carries a live, daily-settling `VX/H7 - 2027-03-17` row, and VIX contract terms settle to the SOQ of the SPX/SPXW series expiring exactly 30 days later — 2027-03-17 + 30d = 2027-04-16. The same 30-day rule reproduces on all nine VX rows that page carries once NYSE closures are applied. Filed estimate, not confirmed: that evidence dates the INDEX-options leg by inference through a contract spec while this entry is a monthly expiration covering index and single-stock options, theocc.com returned HTTP 403 and Cboe's own expiration-calendar URLs 403/404 to this runner on 2026-09-05, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: PROPOSED during the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). Why this one and not the other undated expirations that sweep could have filed: it is not another instance of the same event type, it is the CONSTITUTIVE INPUT to an event this calendar already carries. The 2027-03-17 VIX settlement value (the VRO) is computed from the opening auction of this single SPX/SPXW series and no other, so a calendar holding the settlement but not its strip is incomplete in a way that matters to the ledger reading it. Two properties of this strip are load-bearing for vix-expiration-2027-03-17 and are recorded here so a later pulse does not have to re-derive them. (1) The measurement window 2027-03-18 -> 2027-04-16 spans 30 calendar days but only 21 TRADING sessions, because Good Friday 2027-03-26 (good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, estimate) falls inside it; a holiday-free 30-day strip spans 22. (2) The window also contains the 2027-03-19 quarterly triple witching, quarter-end 2027-03-31, and the start of the Q1-2027 reporting season — it is an event-dense strip, which is part of why the March VIX contract carries the premium it does. This entry itself is an ordinary monthly expiration: no house playbook is opex-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05 for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ, zero hits in both), and its own research burden is a routine one. Impact MEDIUM to match the other monthly expirations on this calendar, not because anything here is actionable. AMENDED 2026-09-05 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/opex-2027-04-16.md, leg 2) — read the title as a class description, not a distinction. Running the +30-day rule across all nine VX rows Cboe's settlement CSV carries lands on a third-Friday SPX expiration nine times out of nine (U6 -> 2026-10-16, V6 -> 11-20, X6 -> 12-18, Z6 -> 2027-01-15, F7 -> 02-19, G7 -> 03-19, H7 -> 04-16, J7 -> 05-21, K7 -> 06-17, the last pulled to a Thursday by Juneteenth observed 2027-06-18), so being 'the SPX strip a VIX settlement is computed from' is what a monthly expiration IS: six of the eight opex entries this calendar carries already satisfy it. The constitutive-input framing above is right about the RELATIONSHIP and wrong to treat it as a distinguishing feature, and the property attaches to 2027-03-17 — the morning the VRO is struck from this series' opening quotes — not to 2027-04-16, thirty days later. The title is left unchanged because it is accurate; this note is the correction to how it should be read. What the initial research found instead: 2027-04-16 is the last NYSE session before the April 2027 FOMC communications blackout (fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17, estimate), which is a deterministic consequence of a late-month meeting rather than an anomaly, and which selects exactly two carried opex entries — this one and the far nearer 2026-10-16.
